comparison.objective: Commission a robot-axis damper vs clear all surgical instruments from a drape into a tray for a complete count.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision fastening and feedback-driven mechanical adjustment vs locating and transferring instruments without leaving any behind.
comparison.success_condition: Two bounded impact cycles with retained setting vs all four instruments in the tray and the drape clear.
comparison.reason: The surgical task is completeness-sensitive pick-and-place; it has no adjustment, locking, or physical-response criterion. Detailed containment/stability thresholds are not present in the record.
